lead.headline: IRAN STRIKES U.S. BASES IN BAHRAIN; TANKERS HIT NEAR HORMUZ
lead.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they hit two U.S. military positions in Bahrain on Saturday, while Bahrain says a civilian industrial site in Sitra caught fire. Two tankers were struck near the Strait of Hormuz. Washington denies an Iranian claim that it damaged an F-16.

stories.headline: Two tankers struck near Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: UK maritime agency reports a stern hit 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman, and an engine-room hit 17 nautical miles east; no casualties listed.

stories.headline: U.S. denies Iran hit an F-16 over the Gulf
stories.summary: U.S. Central Command on 21 Nov denies an Iranian account that its forces fired a missile at a U.S. F-16, damaging it and forcing an emergency landing.

stories.headline: Saudis intercept three Houthi missiles
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition says it stopped three ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh on 21 Nov and struck the Houthi-held port of Hodeidah.

stories.headline: Fire at power station in Iraq kills 4
stories.summary: At least 4 people are killed and 35 injured in a fire at the Hartha power station near Basra on 21 Nov, Iraqi officials say; the toll may rise.

stories.headline: Russian missile hits Zelenskyy's hometown
stories.summary: A Russian ballistic missile strikes central Kryvyi Rih on 21 Nov, killing a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman and wounding about 60.

stories.headline: Russian missiles enter Polish airspace
stories.summary: NATO chief Mark Rutte pledges in Warsaw on 21 Nov to defend every inch of Poland after two Russian missiles and a drone violate its airspace.

stories.headline: Russian cargo ship ablaze in Baltic
stories.summary: A Russian cargo ship linked to the military catches fire in the Gulf of Finland on 21 Nov; Finland says Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack.

stories.headline: Young Europeans protest in 20+ nations
stories.summary: Tens of thousands of young people march in more than 20 European countries on 20-21 Nov over living costs, housing and military spending.

stories.headline: Toxic alcohol kills 11 in India's Manipur
stories.summary: At least 11 people die and more than 180 are hospitalised after drinking toxic alcohol in Manipur state, its chief minister says on 21 Nov.

stories.headline: Magnitude 6.8 quake near Indonesia
stories.summary: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake strikes near Indonesia and Timor-Leste on 21 Nov; no tsunami threat is issued.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen
stories.summary: The first trilateral summit ends with a joint declaration on nuclear risks but no Ukraine breakthrough; Zelenskyy calls Putin a killer.

stories.headline: ICJ: Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide
stories.summary: The UN's top court finds Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya in 2017; Malaysia vows to press the ruling with the OIC and ASEAN.

stories.headline: Boat carrying mourners sinks in Nigeria
stories.summary: A wooden boat ferrying mourners sinks in Nigeria on 21 Nov, killing at least 24 people; rescue operations are under way.

stories.headline: 700,000 displaced in southern Ethiopia
stories.summary: About 700,000 people are displaced in southern Ethiopia on 21 Nov as troops mobilise on the Eritrea border.

stories.headline: S. Africa's first woman deputy president dies
stories.summary: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, South Africa's first woman deputy president and former head of UN Women, dies on 21 Nov aged 71.

stories.headline: Morocco sends officers to Gaza force
stories.summary: Morocco has sent army officers to the international force for Gaza, officials say on 21 Nov.

stories.headline: FBI probes intrusion into police database
stories.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent intrusion involving the National Crime Information Center, a person familiar with the inquiry says on 21 Nov.

stories.headline: Trump backs 10% cap on card interest
stories.summary: President Trump says on 21 Nov he will work with Democrats on a 10% ceiling on credit-card interest rates.

stories.headline: Florida river breaks 73-year flood record
stories.summary: The St. Johns River near Cocoa breaks a 73-year record after days of heavy rain flood towns from Miami to Brevard County.

stories.headline: Jury convicts man over Palisades Fire arson
stories.summary: A federal jury in Los Angeles convicts a man of arson charges for starting the blaze that became the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire.

stories.headline: Mexico captures FBI most-wanted cartel boss
stories.summary: Mexican special forces capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, 'El Chapo Isidro', in Guasave, Sinaloa; 11 people die in the violence that follows.

stories.headline: Deep quake shakes central Peru
stories.summary: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake strikes central Peru, USGS says, felt in Lima; Peru's institute puts it as high as 7.3.

stories.headline: Supercell storm kills three in Brazil
stories.summary: A deadly supercell storm in southern Brazil kills at least three people on 21 Nov, officials say.

stories.headline: Mosquito bacteria cut dengue in Brazil
stories.summary: A study reported on 21 Nov finds mosquitoes carrying Wolbachia bacteria cut dengue cases among children in Brazil.

stories.headline: COP31 runs past deadline over fossil fuels
stories.summary: UN climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, run into overtime on 21 Nov with no deal; the EU says it wants a good deal or no deal.

stories.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil-fuel language
stories.summary: A revised COP31 draft circulated at Antalya drops fossil-fuel language as delegates argue over finance and energy.

stories.headline: Hormuz attacks rattle energy markets
stories.summary: Oil prices jump and shipping slows as tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz disrupt Gulf energy flows on 21 Nov.

stories.headline: Tornado warnings issued in South Florida
stories.summary: Tornado warnings are issued in South Florida on 21 Nov as storms lash the state after days of heavy rain.

stories.headline: UN agrees to regulate 'killer robots'
stories.summary: UN talks on regulating autonomous weapons end on 21 Nov with a pledge to develop new rules within two years, despite Russian opposition.

stories.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury in 8 years
stories.summary: The joint ESA-JAXA BepiColombo spacecraft arrives at Mercury on 21 Nov, sending back its first X-ray images.

stories.headline: U.S. bars three Chinese telecom firms
stories.summary: The U.S. bars three Chinese telecoms from obtaining U.S. phone numbers on 21 Nov; Beijing objects.

stories.headline: Formula 1 to return to V8 engines in 2030
stories.summary: Formula 1 will return to V8 engines from 2030, organisers confirm on 21 Nov.

stories.headline: Harden scores 51, passes Bryant mark
stories.summary: James Harden scores 51 points as Cleveland beats Indiana 128-119 in an NBA Cup game on 21 Nov.

stories.headline: Nations League draw: France face Spain
stories.summary: The Nations League draw on 21 Nov pairs France with Spain; England get Norway.

stories.headline: Deep Purple postpone world tour
stories.summary: Deep Purple postpone the remaining concerts of their 2026 world tour over health problems of singer Ian Gillan, 81.

stories.headline: Sacramento win USL title on penalties
stories.summary: Sacramento Republic beat Louisville on penalties to win the USL Championship on 21 Nov.
